title: HSK 2.9 · 节目, 态度, 方便, 道理, 小时候
focus: 哭 · 怕 · 漂亮 · 度 · 低 · 节目 · 健康 · 弄 · 说明 · 节 · 目的 · 听说 · 明星 · 水平 · 想起 · 态度 · 亮 · 平 · 经理 · 角度 · 那时 · 可怕 · 方便 · 讲话 · 随便 · 随时 · 公园 · 公平 · 的话 · 道路 · 角 · 公路 · 道理 · 公里 · 小说 · 理想 · 平时 · 比如说 · 小时候
body:
Words built from 公 public, 平 flat/even, 道 road/reason, 度 degree and 便 convenient. Notice how 公 makes things 'for everyone': 公园 park, 公路 highway, 公平 fair.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公 | gōng | public | 公园, 公平, 公路, 公里 |
| 平 | píng | flat, level, even | 平, 水平, 公平, 平时 |
| 道 | dào | road; reason | 道路, 道理 |
| 度 | dù | degree, extent (广 + 廿 + 又) | 度, 态度, 角度 |
| 时 | shí | time (日 sun + 寸) | 那时, 随时, 平时, 小时候 |
| 理 | lǐ | reason, order (王 jade + 里 lǐ sound) | 经理, 道理, 理想 |
| 便 | biàn | convenient (亻 + 更) | 方便, 随便 |
| 节 | jié | section; festival | 节, 节目 |

## Watch out

- 漂亮 is piàoliang, with a neutral 亮; on its own 亮 is liàng.
- 的话 is pronounced dehuà; 的 is neutral.
- 目的 is mùdì: here 的 is dì (target), not de.

cards.Example: 孩子哭了。 háizi kū le: The child is crying
cards.Notes: Two 口 (crying eyes or mouths) over 犬 dog. Lookalike: 器 qì (four 口)

cards.Example: 我不怕。 wǒ bú pà: I'm not scared.
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 白 bái, sound shifted to pà

cards.Example: 她真漂亮。 tā zhēn piàoliang: She's really pretty
cards.Notes: 漂 (氵 + 票 piào, sound) + 亮 bright = bright and pretty

cards.Example: 今天三十度。 jīntiān sānshí dù: It's 30 degrees today
cards.Notes: 广 + 廿 + 又 hand: to measure. Degree, extent: 温度 temperature

cards.Example: 声音低一点。 shēngyīn dī yìdiǎn: Lower your voice a bit
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 氐 dǐ (sound) = low. Opposite: 高 gāo

cards.Example: 我喜欢这个节目。 wǒ xǐhuan zhège jiémù: I like this show
cards.Notes: 节 section + 目 item, list = an item on the program

cards.Example: 祝你身体健康！ zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng: Wishing you good health!
cards.Notes: 健 strong (亻 + 建 jiàn, sound) + 康 well, peaceful = healthy

cards.Example: 你把我弄醒了。 nǐ bǎ wǒ nòng xǐng le: You woke me up
cards.Notes: 王 jade above 廾 two hands: handling something in your hands. A catch-all 'do'

cards.Example: 这说明他很忙。 zhè shuōmíng tā hěn máng: That shows he's busy
cards.Notes: 说 say + 明 clear = make clear, explain

cards.Example: 我今天有两节课。 wǒ jīntiān yǒu liǎng jié kè: I have two classes today
cards.Notes: From 節 (⺮ bamboo top). Originally a bamboo joint, so a section; also 春节 festival

cards.Example: 你来这里的目的是什么？ nǐ lái zhèlǐ de mùdì shì shénme: Why are you here?
cards.Notes: 目 eye, aim + 的 target (dì here) = the target you aim at

cards.Example: 我听说你要结婚了。 wǒ tīngshuō nǐ yào jiéhūn le: I hear you're getting married
cards.Notes: 听 hear + 说 say = to hear it said

cards.Example: 他是个大明星。 tā shì ge dà míngxīng: He's a big star
cards.Notes: 明 bright + 星 star = bright star, celebrity

cards.Example: 你的中文水平很高。 nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng hěn gāo: Your Chinese is very good
cards.Notes: 水 water + 平 flat = level as water's surface, so 'level'

cards.Example: 我想起来了！ wǒ xiǎng qǐlai le: Now I remember!
cards.Notes: 想 think + 起 rise = for a thought to rise up, recall

cards.Example: 他的态度很好。 tā de tàidu hěn hǎo: He has a good attitude
cards.Notes: 态 manner (太 tài sound + 心 heart) + 度 degree = attitude

cards.Example: 天亮了。 tiān liàng le: It's getting light
cards.Notes: A shortened 高 high on top + 几 (from 儿 person) below. 月亮 moon, 漂亮 pretty

cards.Example: 这条路很平。 zhè tiáo lù hěn píng: This road is flat
cards.Notes: Symmetrical, balanced shape: flat, even. Also a tie score: 二比二平

cards.Example: 我们经理很好。 wǒmen jīnglǐ hěn hǎo: Our manager is nice
cards.Notes: 经 manage (纟 thread) + 理 put in order = the one who manages

cards.Example: 换个角度想想。 huàn ge jiǎodù xiǎngxiang: Look at it from another angle
cards.Notes: 角 corner, angle + 度 degree = angle, viewpoint

cards.Example: 那时我还很小。 nàshí wǒ hái hěn xiǎo: I was still little then
cards.Notes: 那 that + 时 time = at that time

cards.Example: 这个电影很可怕。 zhège diànyǐng hěn kěpà: This movie is scary
cards.Notes: 可 can, worth + 怕 fear = fear-worthy, scary

cards.Example: 坐地铁很方便。 zuò dìtiě hěn fāngbiàn: Taking the subway is convenient
cards.Notes: 方 way + 便 convenient = convenient, handy

cards.Example: 上课不要讲话。 shàngkè búyào jiǎnghuà: No talking in class
cards.Notes: 讲 speak + 话 words = to talk, give a speech

cards.Example: 你随便坐。 nǐ suíbiàn zuò: Sit wherever you like
cards.Notes: 随 follow (阝 + 辶) + 便 convenient = follow what's convenient, as you like

cards.Example: 你随时来找我。 nǐ suíshí lái zhǎo wǒ: Come find me any time
cards.Notes: 随 follow + 时 time = whenever, any time

cards.Example: 我们去公园走走。 wǒmen qù gōngyuán zǒuzou: Let's walk in the park
cards.Notes: 公 public + 园 garden (囗 enclosure + 元 yuán, sound) = public garden, park

cards.Example: 这样不公平！ zhèyàng bù gōngpíng: That's not fair!
cards.Notes: 公 public, impartial + 平 even = fair to everyone

cards.Meaning: if (at the end of an if-clause)
cards.Example: 下雨的话就不去了。 xiàyǔ dehuà jiù bú qù le: If it rains, we won't go
cards.Notes: 的 + 话 words: '…such words' = if so. Often with 如果: 如果…的话

cards.Example: 这条道路很宽。 zhè tiáo dàolù hěn kuān: This road is wide
cards.Notes: 道 road + 路 road (足 foot + 各 sound) = road, way

cards.Example: 这个三块五角。 zhège sān kuài wǔ jiǎo: This is 3.50 yuan
cards.Notes: Picture of an animal horn. Spoken money: 角 = 毛. Read jué in 角色 role

cards.Example: 这条公路很长。 zhè tiáo gōnglù hěn cháng: This highway is long
cards.Notes: 公 public + 路 road = public road, highway

cards.Example: 你说得有道理。 nǐ shuō de yǒu dàoli: You have a point
cards.Notes: 道 way, principle + 理 reason = the reason, logic. 有道理 = makes sense

cards.Example: 学校离这里两公里。 xuéxiào lí zhèlǐ liǎng gōnglǐ: School is 2 km from here
cards.Notes: 公 (metric, standard) + 里 lǐ (Chinese mile) = kilometer

cards.Example: 我在看一本小说。 wǒ zài kàn yì běn xiǎoshuō: I'm reading a novel
cards.Notes: 小 small + 说 talk = 'small talk', stories (as opposed to serious writing), novel

cards.Example: 你的理想是什么？ nǐ de lǐxiǎng shì shénme: What's your dream?
cards.Notes: 理 reason, ideal + 想 think = what you think should be, an ideal

cards.Example: 你平时几点起床？ nǐ píngshí jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng: When do you usually get up?
cards.Notes: 平 ordinary, even + 时 time = ordinary times, usually

cards.Example: 比如说，你可以学画画。 bǐrúshuō, nǐ kěyǐ xué huàhuà: For example, you could learn to paint
cards.Notes: 比 compare + 如 like + 说 say = say, comparing to… = for example

cards.Example: 我小时候很胖。 wǒ xiǎoshíhou hěn pàng: I was chubby as a kid
cards.Notes: 小 small + 时候 time = the time when (I was) small
